_README.description: Model metadata for native Anthropic (Claude) API access.
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the Anthropic provider. Aliases are case-insensitive and deliberately mirror the OpenRouter catalog's names so dual-key setups reroute to the direct API without retraining anyone.
_README.catalog_policy: Latest two generations per family (verified against the LiteLLM catalog at implementation time, 2026-08-13): Opus 5 + Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5 + Sonnet 4.6, Fable 5, Haiku 4.5. Fable is a single-generation family (first model of its line) and Claude 3.5 Haiku is retired from the API, so those families contribute one entry each. Undated model IDs are used on purpose: they track the latest snapshot and match LiteLLM's catalog keys exactly, so auto-discovery enrichment merges cleanly.

field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.max_thinking_tokens: Maximum extended-thinking budget the provider will allocate; actual budgets are mode-scaled percentages of this and always leave output headroom inside max_tokens
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports the Messages API extended-thinking parameter
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering

models.description: Fable 5 (1M context) - Anthropic's most intelligent generally available model; Mythos-class tier of the Claude 5 family
Opus 5 (1M context) - Claude 5 family frontier reasoning model
Sonnet 5 (1M context) - Claude 5 family balanced flagship; default 'claude' alias
Opus 4.8 (1M context) - final Claude 4 generation Opus
Sonnet 4.6 (1M context) - final Claude 4 generation Sonnet
Haiku 4.5 (200K context) - fast, low-latency Claude with extended thinking
